caption: The drawing depicts a pair of long, brown metal tongs with hooked ends. The tongs are positioned diagonally from the lower left to the upper right corner of the image, crossing each other near the top where they are joined at the pivot. Each arm of the tongs curves outward and then forms an inward-facing hook at the handle end. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color, and the objects are outlined and shaded with a brown hue, giving them a three-dimensional appearance. The drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border line close to the edges of the paper. There is a small handwritten signature or label in the bottom right corner.
title: Pot Hooks
